what: fair on a single-span cubic extrusion holding its edges: every control row is a boundary row or the one next to it, so nothing moves
method: the face: the Bezier (0,0), (13,8), (27,-8), (40,0) on XZ extruded 20 along -y or +y, B-spline degree (3, 1), one span each way. keep_edges holds the two boundary rows each side and the rows next to them: across the cubic that is all 4 rows, so the surface is unchanged: area = curve length 41.3983 (Gauss-Legendre 64) x 20 = 827.966
